Curtain wall installation in Winnipeg

We supply and install aluminum curtain wall systems on new buildings and additions. Layout, anchors, framing, glass and seals are done by the same crew, so the wall is plumb, tight and ready for inspection.

We work from the approved shop drawings and the manufacturer’s installation instructions. Anchors, alignment and joint sizes are checked before the glass goes in, because that is where leaks and call-backs start.

Typical jobs are new commercial and mixed-use buildings, additions, and glazed stair and elevator towers.

Request a quote

What is included

  • Supply and installation of the complete system
  • Layout and anchor installation
  • Mullions, pressure plates and caps
  • Glass, spandrel and panel infill
  • Perimeter seals and air/vapour barrier tie-in

Common questions

Do you supply the curtain wall or only install it?
We supply and install. You get one price and one company responsible for the material, the installation and the finished wall.
What do you need to price a curtain wall job?
The elevations, the curtain wall shop drawings if they are ready, and the schedule. Early in a project the architectural drawings are enough for a budget price.
Do you work outside Winnipeg?
Yes. We are based in Winnipeg and take projects across Manitoba.
